title: How do we draw an angle of thirty degrees?
description: A base ray is drawn, the protractor is placed with its centre on the vertex and its zero line on the base ray, and the degrees are counted from that zero up to thirty. Keeko thinks the count can start from either zero.
teaching_notes: One idea: to draw an angle of a given size, count the degrees from the zero line that lies on the base ray. Watch for students who count from the zero at the other end of the protractor.

source: Vidya wants to draw a 30° angle and name it ∠TIN using a pro
video_script.why: The child learns the steps to draw an angle of a given size with a protractor, with the base ray on the zero line and the count starting at zero.
video_script.substitution: The angle TIN of thirty degrees of the book's example.
video_script.anchor: the protractor of the book, with its centre point, its zero lines and its scales
video_script.wrong_answer: we can count thirty from either zero
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks we can count thirty from either zero. The other scale starts at zero on the other end, so counting thirty from there draws a very wide angle, and the doubt is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: Angle tee eye en is thirty degrees

final_answer.spoken: angle tee eye en is thirty degrees

names.Ruhee: book character who draws an angle of thirty degrees with a protractor

never_show: a wide angle of 150 degrees as the angle TIN
maths_rules: the vertex is I, the arms are IT and IN, and IN is the base
the centre of the protractor lies on the vertex I
the base ray IN lies along the zero line
count the degrees from that zero, in tens, up to 30, and mark the point T at the label 30
join I and T with a ruler, and angle TIN = 30 degrees
slip: counting 30 on the scale that starts at the other zero draws a wide angle of 150 degrees
video_script.design: One idea: draw a base ray, put the zero line on it, count from zero, and join. The protractor stays on the board all video, and the count runs along its scale one ten at a time.
open_questions: The book prints the count as zero, ten, thirty, which leaves out twenty. The video counts zero, ten, twenty, thirty.

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Angle tee eye en is thirty degrees.
The base ray is eye en, and the arm eye tee is turned thirty degrees from it.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks we can count thirty from either zero.
<bookmark mark='other'/>But the other scale starts at zero on the other end. Its thirty lies far from the base ray.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Count from the zero that lies on the base ray.
